critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/stones.py :: update_stone_details — clean implementation. Uses positional operator `stones.$` correctly, recomputes fee from the job's current service_type bracket table (matches add_stone_to_job), enforces cancelled-stone 400, respects certificate-group mounted dedup (only bills mounted_fee once per group), and log_activity is wrapped in try/except so activity-log outages don't fail the write. Response payload {stone, new_fee, job_total_fee} is exactly what the frontend consumes.

frontend page.tsx wiring — handleOpenEditStone reads the full stone from selectedJob.stones (not from the row's projected fields) so all patch fields are populated correctly. handleSaveEditStone calls fetchData() AND getAll() then re-selects the job by id — a bit redundant (two refetches) but harmless; a single fetchData() should suffice since selectedJob is derived from jobs.

EditStoneDialog — solid. All 6 spec'd data-testids present (edit-stone-dialog, edit-stone-type-select, edit-stone-weight-input, edit-stone-value-input, edit-stone-shape-select, edit-stone-cs-toggle, edit-stone-mounted-toggle, confirm-edit-stone-button). Save disabled while saving OR when required fields empty. Enter-on-value submits like AddStoneDialog for muscle-memory.

MINOR polish (non-blocking): after save the file logs `[edit-stone] new fee $X, job total $Y` via console.log — leaving instrumentation logs in prod is not ideal; consider removing or gating behind a debug flag before shipping.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Login automation: the Cloudflare Turnstile widget on /login cannot be bypassed via UI even with TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY empty on backend — the frontend requires the widget's own token before enabling submit. Workaround (proven this iter): call POST /api/auth/login via page.request, then sessionStorage.setItem('token', jwt) AND sessionStorage.setItem('auth-storage', JSON.stringify({state:{token,user,isAuthenticated:true},version:0})). Zustand-persist key is 'auth-storage'. 2) Jobs on the /dashboard/jobs list are clickable rows [data-testid=job-row-{job_number}], which open an in-page modal (not a route change). 3) Edit mode: click [data-testid=edit-job-button] inside the job modal — this exposes the per-stone Pencil button [data-testid=edit-stone-{stone_id}]. 4) EditStoneDialog testids all match the spec. 5) Frontend is static export served by `serve build`; source edits require `cd /app/frontend && yarn build` — build was fresh (09:16) at start of this run, so no rebuild was needed.
